description: Trigger + output evals for the branded (Contoso letterhead) Molina FSA aggregation PDF renderer. should_trigger cases ask for the branded/letterhead/fancy FSA PDF; should_not_trigger near-misses must route to the plain PDF skill (molina-fsa-aggregator-pdf), the math-only aggregators, or are out of scope (Sheet2/PII).

should_trigger: generate the branded FSA funding PDF
produce the fancy Molina FSA run summary as a document
export the monthly FSA roll-up on the Contoso letterhead
make the FSA summary PDF with the letterhead
give me the FSA aggregation as a polished PDF
should_not_trigger: run the FSA aggregation and give me a plain PDF
just show me the FSA totals as a table
what is the aggregation math for the FSA accounts
give me per-employee FSA detail from Sheet2

near_misses.query: run the FSA aggregation and give me a PDF
near_misses.note: Ambiguous branded-vs-plain. If the user does not ask for branded/letterhead/fancy, prefer molina-fsa-aggregator-pdf (plain). This skill wins only when branding/letterhead/'fancy'/polished is requested.

near_misses.query: total the FSA reports and show me the numbers
near_misses.note: Math/inline-table only -> molina-fsa-aggregator-pdf / -singlefile, not this document renderer.

output_evals.name: branded_render_of_sample
output_evals.given: python scripts/render_pdf.py evals/sample_input.json -o out.pdf (run from the skill folder; letterhead present in assets/).
assert: Exit code 0 and stdout ends with '..., branded).' (not 'UNBRANDED').

The rendered page shows the Contoso letterhead: blue header 'CONTOSO HEALTHCARE', green divider rule, bottom-right footer box (Contoso Healthcare / www.contosohealthcare.com / 1-800-555-CARE), faint diagonal watermark.
Body contains headings 'FSA Aggregation - Run Summary', 'Final Summary Table', 'Per-File Contributions', 'Processed Files List (2)'.
Final Summary shows $22,609.72, $708.19, $6,325.23, $400.58; the Per-File TOTAL row equals the Final Summary column-wise.
Page number 'Page 1 of 1' appears bottom-LEFT (bottom-right is the letterhead footer box).

output_evals.name: deterministic_bytes
output_evals.given: Render evals/sample_input.json twice to two files.
assert: SHA-256(render_a) == SHA-256(render_b) — identical input + same letterhead yields byte-identical PDF.

output_evals.name: scales_and_clears_letterhead
assert: Every page carries the letterhead and a bottom-left page number.
No table content overlaps the header band or the bottom-right footer box.

output_evals.name: refuses_unbranded_by_default
assert: Non-zero exit (3) and an ERROR on stderr; no unbranded PDF is written.
Adding --allow-unbranded instead exits 0 and prints '..., UNBRANDED).'

output_evals.name: cli_help_works
assert: Exit code 0 and usage/help text is printed (no traceback).

output_evals.name: phi_safe
assert: No employee names or identifiers appear — aggregate totals only (Sheet1-derived).
